stages.name: Hermite Motion
stages.tagline: After Effects–style animation control, inside Resolve.
stages.summary: One-click motion presets, a bezier easing curve editor, and speed-ramp tools — so smooth keyframe animation doesn't require hand-editing curves in Fusion.

features.title: Motion preset pack (.drfx)
features.blurb: Slide-in (4 directions), pop/scale-in, ken burns pan-zoom, and fade+move combos as reusable Fusion macros with Inspector controls. One double-click to install.

features.title: Bezier easing curve editor
features.blurb: Draggable-handle curve UI with a preset library — linear, ease, ease-in-out, overshoot, bounce — applied to real keyframes on a selected Fusion node.

features.title: Speed-ramp graph editor
features.blurb: Click-drag speed curves with ease handles and hold/freeze segments, modeled on the After Effects graph editor.

features.title: Batch apply
features.blurb: Select multiple clips, apply one preset to all of them at once.

stages.name: Hermite Subs
stages.tagline: Auto-subtitles that never leave your machine.
stages.summary: On-device transcription and captioning — model choice, voice activity detection, styling presets, and a correction pass before anything touches your timeline. No cloud calls.

features.title: On-device transcription
features.blurb: Choice of model size and family — small and fast, or larger and more accurate — running entirely on your machine.

features.title: Voice activity detection
features.blurb: Silence is skipped before transcription, so long timelines process faster.

features.title: Styled subtitle tracks
features.blurb: Auto-generated Resolve subtitle/Text+ tracks with adjustable styling presets — font, position, background, karaoke-style highlight.

features.title: Correction pass
features.blurb: A waveform + text editor to fix errors before committing to the timeline. Nothing is written without your review.

features.title: Speaker diarization
features.blurb: Identify and label different speakers in the transcript.

stages.name: Hermite AI
stages.tagline: A local AI layer you choose the brain for.
stages.summary: A swappable on-device model layer — pick the lightweight local model that fits your RAM and GPU, starting with caption punctuation and cleanup.

features.title: Model picker & manager
features.blurb: Supported local models listed with disk and RAM requirements shown before download, plus version management. Swap models without touching the rest of the app.

features.title: Caption punctuation & cleanup
features.blurb: The first concrete AI use case: a bounded, low-risk pass that directly improves transcription output.

features.title: Optional cloud pass (opt-in)
features.blurb: A clearly labeled, off-by-default higher-quality cloud option for users who want it. Never a silent fallback — your data stays local unless you explicitly opt in.

stages.name: Hermite API
stages.tagline: Hermite's engine, callable by your tools and agents.
stages.summary: A cloud-hosted enterprise API exposing curve generation, motion presets, transcription, and caption cleanup as stateless endpoints — with MCP integration so AI agents can call Hermite as a tool. Cloud by design, clearly separated from the on-device product.

features.title: REST API
features.blurb: Easing-curve generation, motion-preset application, transcription-as-a-service, and AI caption cleanup as well-documented, stateless endpoints.

features.title: API keys & usage billing
features.blurb: API key auth with usage-based or seat-based enterprise plans, separate from the desktop app's consumer licensing.

features.title: Rate limiting & usage dashboards
features.blurb: Programmatic-load guardrails and visibility from day one.

features.title: MCP integration via Composio
features.blurb: Hermite registered as a Composio toolkit, so Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible agent can call it as tool calls.
